一、整体分镜表（表格母版）提示词

（适配 Stable Diffusion / Midjourney 等工具，用于生成和原图一模一样的分镜总览图）
masterpiece, best quality, ultra-detailed, 8K, photorealistic, cinematic style, movie storyboard template,
16:9 aspect ratio, horizontal layout, multi-panel storyboard sheet,
layout structure:
- Top title bar with text "《退婚风波 / 议事厅对峙 / 分镜：叶枫闯入》" and metadata: duration 0-15s, style: cinematic realism / ancient fantasy, aspect ratio 16:9, color tone: bright indoor / cool white lantern light / subtle wood reflection, sound: no background music / sound effects, keywords: council chamber, backlight, confrontation, entering, divorce annulment
- Left column: "场景参考" (wide shot of ancient Chinese council chamber, dark wood interior, red lanterns, symmetrical layout) + "人物参考" (4 full-body character portraits: Ye Cang (old man in black robes), Ye Feng (young swordsman in tattered white/black outfit), Ouyang Feng (blue-robed noble), Ouyang Xue (white-robed young woman)) + "灯光与质感参考" (6 small reference images: redwood desk, cool white lantern top light, doorway backlight silhouette, reflective bluestone floor, dark aged wood texture, wall weapon decor)
- Middle column: "顶视机位与站位示意" (top-down floor plan of council chamber, labeled camera positions 1-5, character markers for Ye Cang, Ye Feng, Ouyang Feng, Ouyang Xue, yellow dashed camera movement lines, text notes "大厅顶部冷白色灯笼光 青石板地面微弱反光" and "门口逆光方向") + "分镜头画面预览" (5 storyboard panels, each with panel number, duration, shot type, and description text below)
- Right column: "拍摄执行流程" (5 sketch panels showing the sequence: Ye Cang turning back, Ye Feng entering backlit, Ye Cang shouting, Ye Feng walking unimpeded, Ye Feng declaring his words)
clean layout, technical drawing style, clear text labels, professional film storyboard, ancient Chinese fantasy setting, consistent color palette, no clutter, organized panels
二、分镜头逐帧独立提示词（5个镜头，完全还原原图）

镜头01（中景镜头 / 固定镜头，3秒）
cinematic shot, medium shot, fixed camera, 3 seconds,
ancient Chinese council chamber interior, old man Ye Cang (long white hair, black traditional robes) half-turned to the camera, standing by a redwood desk, head turning back, serious and suspicious expression,
cool white lantern light from above, dark wood walls with calligraphy scrolls, reflective bluestone floor,
cinematic realism, movie still, sharp focus, detailed textures, dim moody lighting,
sound effect notes: hall echo, fabric rustle, footsteps (off-screen)
镜头02（摇镜，3秒）
cinematic shot, panning shot, 3 seconds,
wide shot of a young swordsman Ye Feng in backlit silhouette, walking through a large wooden doorway into the council chamber, long dark hair, tattered white/black martial arts outfit, sword on back,
doorway backlight creates a glowing outline, interior dim with cool lantern light,
cinematic realism, movie still, dynamic movement blur on the panning motion, atmospheric haze,
sound effect notes: footsteps, fabric rustle, hall echo
镜头03（近景镜头 / 固定镜头，3秒）
cinematic shot, close-up medium shot, fixed camera, 3 seconds,
close-up of Ye Cang's face (old man with long white hair and beard), frowning, angry expression, eyes locked on the viewer (Ye Feng),
cool white light from above casting soft shadows on his face, dark wood background out of focus,
cinematic realism, movie still, dramatic lighting, high detail on facial features,
dialogue text overlay: 叶苍：【厉声呵斥】“叶枫！你怎么来了？这里没有你的事，快回房休息去！”
sound effect notes: fabric rustle, hall echo
镜头04（跟拍镜头 / 低角度，3秒）
cinematic shot, tracking shot, low angle, 3 seconds,
low-angle close-up of Ye Feng's feet walking across the reflective bluestone floor, tattered black boots, slow and steady steps, floor reflecting his figure and the lantern light,
background shows wooden furniture out of focus,
cinematic realism, movie still, dynamic low angle, sense of imposing presence,
sound effect notes: footsteps, fabric rustle, floor echo
镜头05（特写镜头 / 极近推镜，3秒）
cinematic shot, extreme close-up, push-in shot, 3 seconds,
extreme close-up of Ye Feng's eyes, intense and determined gaze, messy dark hair framing his face, faint scars on his cheek,
cool side lighting creating dramatic shadows, eyes reflecting the council chamber light,
cinematic realism, movie still, sharp focus on the eyes, emotional intensity,
dialogue text overlay: 叶枫：【铿锵有力】“怎么没有我的事？这婚约，是我和欧阳雪订的，要退婚，也应该是我叶枫，轮不到你们。”
sound effect notes: heavy breathing, hall echo
三、关键风格与技术参数（可直接复用）
项目 精准还原参数 
整体风格 电影级写实 + 古风玄幻，16:9画幅，无明显AI痕迹，电影分镜质感 
色调与光影 白天室内场景，冷白色灯笼顶光 + 门口逆光轮廓，青石板地面弱反光，深色旧木质感，低对比度但高细节 
核心关键词 议事厅对峙、逆光轮廓、人物站位、顶视机位示意、分镜流程、古装武侠、退婚名场面 
附加细节 墙面兵器装饰、红木桌案、 calligraphy scrolls, dim lantern glow, atmospheric haze, subtle motion blur on moving shots 

按这个提示词的格式来出我故事的分镜图15秒宫斗对话剧本

（场景：御花园廊下，贵妃偶遇新晋婕妤，四周寂静）

婕妤：（屈膝行礼）臣妾参见贵妃娘娘。
贵妃：（瞥一眼她鬓边珠花，冷笑）这东珠成色，倒像本宫赏给掌事宫女的旧物。
婕妤：（指尖微攥，垂眸）娘娘说笑，臣妾出身微寒，只配用这些粗陋物件。
贵妃：（缓步走近，压低声音）安分守拙才好，别仗着几分恩宠，就忘了自己的身份。
婕妤：（抬头一瞬，目光清冷）臣妾谨记，不敢僭越半分。
